en.home_sub: 8 practical, presentation-driven lessons designed to take you from your very first line of local Git version control all the way to building and deploying production-ready web apps with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, PostgreSQL with Neon Database, Vercel, and AI Prompt Engineering.
en.home_stat_4_lbl: English & ភាសាខ្មែរ
en.l1_desc: Master local version control on your machine. Learn repository initialization, file tracking, staging, commits, branches, and the 4-layer mental model.
en.l2_desc: Connect local projects to the cloud. Configure remotes, push code, handle branches, clone repositories, and collaborate with teams using Pull Requests.
en.l3_title: Next.js: The React Framework for the Web
en.l3_desc: Build modern fullstack web applications with React 19 and the Next.js App Router. Master Server Components, file-based routing, nested layouts, and API routes.
en.l4_desc: Style clean, responsive, production interfaces without leaving your HTML. Learn utility classes, flexbox/grid layouts, responsive breakpoints, and dark mode.
en.l5_desc: Assemble accessible, production-grade component systems using Radix UI primitives, Tailwind CSS, and the modern CLI. Customize design tokens with ease.
en.l6_desc: Master relational database architecture, psql CLI, data modeling, indexes, ACID transactions, migrations, and serverless PostgreSQL with Neon branching.
en.l7_desc: Master real-world Next.js web deployment from GitHub to Vercel. Configure Neon PostgreSQL, custom domains, DNS records, HTTPS, and production rollbacks.
en.l8_desc: Master prompt engineering, logical reasoning, codebase analysis, and safe coding agent workflows. Learn to evaluate evidence, plan architecture, and verify results.
en.l9_desc: From your first domain and DNS records to global CDN, WAF, Workers, R2 storage, SSL/TLS, and edge deployment for resilient web systems.
en.home_footer_hint: Tip: Press 1 to 8 to jump directly to any lesson. Press T to toggle Light / Dark mode.

km.l2_level: កម្រិតដំបូង

km.l2_meta: ២០ ស្លាយ • លើ Cloud & Remote
km.l3_level: កម្រិតមធ្យម

km.l3_desc: បង្កើត Web Application ទំនើបជាមួយ React 19 និង App Router របស់ Next.js។ ស្វែងយល់ពី Server vs Client Components, Nested Layouts និង API Route Handlers។
km.l3_meta: ១២ ស្លាយ • React Fullstack
km.l4_level: កម្រិតដំបូង / មធ្យម

km.l4_desc: រចនា UI ស្អាត ទាន់សម័យ និង Responsive ដោយផ្ទាល់ក្នុងកូដរបស់អ្នក។ ចេះប្រើ Utility Classes, Flexbox/Grid, Breakpoints និង Dark Mode។
km.l4_meta: ១២ ស្លាយ • Modern CSS
km.l5_level: កម្រិតមធ្យម
km.l5_title: Shadcn UI: សមាសភាគ Component ទំនើប
km.l5_desc: ផ្គុំបណ្ដុំ UI Components ដែលមានភាពងាយស្រួលប្រើប្រាស់ (Accessible) ដោយប្រើ Radix UI Primitives, Tailwind CSS និង CLI។ កែសម្រួល Theme បានយ៉ាងងាយ។
km.l5_meta: ១២ ស្លាយ • Component System
km.l6_level: កម្រិតមធ្យម / Production
km.l6_desc: ស្វែងយល់អំពីរចនាសម្ព័ន្ធ Relational Database, កម្មវិធី psql CLI, ការរចនា Schema, Indexes, ACID Transactions, Migrations, និង Serverless Postgres ជាមួយ Neon Branching។
km.l6_meta: ៧២ ស្លាយ • Relational & Serverless
km.l7_level: កម្រិតមធ្យម / Production
km.l7_desc: ស្វែងយល់ពីការ Deploy គម្រោង Next.js ជាក់ស្ដែងពី GitHub ទៅកាន់ Vercel។ រៀបចំ Neon PostgreSQL, Custom Domain, DNS Records, HTTPS, និងការ Rollback លើ Production។
km.l7_meta: ៧២ ស្លាយ • Cloud & Production
km.l8_level: កម្រិតខ្ពស់ / AI-Assisted
km.l8_title: Prompt Engineering & ការអភិវឌ្ឍជាមួយ AI
km.l8_desc: ស្វែងយល់ស៊ីជម្រៅពី Prompt Engineering, ការគិតបែបរិះគន់, ការវិភាគ Codebase, និងដំណើរការការងារប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាមួយ AI Coding Agents ព្រមទាំងការផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់លទ្ធផល។
km.l8_meta: ៧៥ ស្លាយ • Critical Thinking & AI
km.l9_level: កម្រិតមធ្យម / Production
km.l9_title: Cloudflare: ហេដ្ឋារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធ Global Edge
km.l9_desc: ចាប់ពីការចុះឈ្មោះ Domain និងកំណត់ត្រា DNS ដំបូង រហូតដល់ Global CDN, WAF, Workers, R2 Storage, SSL/TLS និងប្រព័ន្ធ Edge សម្រាប់ Web កម្រិត Production។
